title: Iimaanka Carshiga Ka Dambeeya
intro: Nafaha qaar laguma tijaabiyo dab ama daad, laakiin waxaa lagu tijaabiyaa cadaadis gaabis ah oo ka yimaada ku noolaanshaha qasriga kaligii-taliye. Qofkani wuxuu ag taagnaa taliye sheeganaya ilaahnimo dadkooda, haddana si qarsoodi ah ugu dheggan iimaanka Ilaaha runta ah ee keliya. Markii la ogaaday daacadnimadooda, waxaa timid dhibaato - laakiin sidoo kale ballanqaad rabbaani ah ayaa dhacay. Ma qiyaasi kartaa cidda uu yahay kan?
clues: Waxaan ku noolaa saqafka sare ee taliyaha ugu awoodda badan dhulkayga, meel ay dad yar qiyaasi karaan.
Xaaskaygu wuxuu hor istaagay dadka oo wuxuu isku sheegay ilaah - laakiin qalbigaygu wuxuu u ahaa Rabbiga Runta ah ee keliya.
Waxaan si qarsoodi ah u duceysan jiray, anigoo ka baqaya ciqaabta ku dhacda dhammaan kuwa caasiyoobay xaaskayga.
Markii iimaankayga la muujiyay, waa la i qabtay oo la i jirdilay - haddana carrabkaygu weligiis ma uusan odhan eray aan run ahayn.
Waxaan qalbigayga u shubay Rabbigay, anigoo weydiisanaya guri Jannada ah, oo ka fog xumaan kasta.
Waxaan ahay Aasiya bint Muzahim — xaaskii Fircoon ee ka soo horjeedday Muuse iyo Haaruun.

identity.label: Kumaan ahay?
options: Aasiya bint Muzahim (Xaaska Fircoon)
Hawwa (Xaawa), haweeneydii ugu horreysay
Saarah, xaaskii ugu horreysay ee Ibraahim
Haagaar, Ismaaciil hooyadiis
Hooyadii Maryam (xaaskii Cimraan)

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo

Ku noolaanshaha caloosha kalluun weyn
Samaynta doon weyn si looga baxsado daad
In lagu tuuro dab ololaya
Markhaati ka noqoshada kala qaybsanaanta bad weyn
trial.answer: Jirdil loo geysto diidmada ka noqoshada iimaanka

options: Waxaa lagu sharfay hoy Janno ah oo ay la joogaan kuwa xaqa ah

Waxaa lagu gubay olol laakiin waxaa badbaadiyay faragelin rabbaani ah

outcome.answer: Waxaa lagu sharfay hoy Janno ah oo ay la joogaan kuwa xaqa ah

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
